Instead, Travelocity defaults to debit because it cost them much less in transaction fees. I understand the motivation, but I’m not big on a business that puts its needs ahead of the customer. Consumers are much better protected by credit card charges than by debit charges. Also, using debit cards can result in a much longer hold on fees and funds in your account. Beware! Travelocity isn’t what it used to be.. On September 15, 2025 my wife and I used the app Travelocity to book a rental car reservation from Sixt to our upcoming Florida family vacation from December 21 2025 to January 1 2026. Immediately after booking the reservation and paying the fee, we noticed on the confirmation email that the rental dates were changed to September 21 to October 1. We immediately called Travelocity. They said we needed to call Sixt. We called Sixt and after a long and heated exchange they said “we will not refund your money.” If you want to switch the reservation to December - January, your rate will be ~$3,000. I called Travelocity back and they said there was nothing they could do so I opened a dispute with my credit card company. Since then we have made another reservation directly with a reputable rental competitor. We have also provided all written evidence and filed complaints with the FBI, FTC, and Florida’s Attorney General’s office. I hope it won’t be long until these types of Unfair and Deceptive Acts and Practices are stopped with heavy fines for good.

reviews.text: Travelocity Gives no Help (SCAM). BEWARE OF TRAVELOCITY!!! I suggest using Google Hotel search and book directly with the hotel. You get good deals and better service and treatment. DELETE YOUR ACCOUNT AND TRAVELOCITY APP AND MOVE ON TO SOMETHING BETTER Travelocity allows vendors to treat customer poorly, refuse to help, and still charge full price for services not provided. We booked 3 nights at Harrah’s in Biloxi. We arrived at 9:10pm after a 9hr drive and our non-smoking room was not available. They said there is a 45min wait for the non-smoking room to be cleaned. We waited. At 10:00pm, we were able to enter our room. We unpacked and went to bed. Between 2am and 3am we went into the bathroom and the floor was sticky with dirty toilet water seeping from the base of the toilet. At 9:20am in the morning, we asked the front desk to move us from the dirty room. They said they didn’t know if they had a room until after 11am check out. They will text us when a room is available. After 6 hours (3:30p) of no communication from the hotel, we returned to the front desk asking about the room. The front desk was extremely rude and could not answer if we had a room. We weren’t willing to be strung along until evening to know if we will have a replacement room. We wanted to relax from a long day. We said just cancel the reservation and we’ll find another place. The front desk proceeded to be rude and condescension. We asked for a receipt. They said we cancelled it and can’t provide that documentation and then threatened to call security. We asked again for some confirmation and the from desk call security so we left. Afterwards I messaged Travelocity about the poor treatment and the hotel not providing a replacement room and that we are without a hotel. Travelocity did nothing to help with the situation and in the end still billed us for the 2 other nights even though the hotel couldn’t provide the room and cancelled the reservation from what they said and refused to provide documentation. We ended up staying at a nice Marriott Courtyard I searched using Google Hotel and book directly with the hotel vendor. Travelocity ruined our vacation and we ended up leaving a day early.
